subject: Clarifying marketing visibility & NDA boundaries for MSA + Order Form
messages:
From: Sophie Carter <sophie@velasys.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hsiao <tom.hsiao@velasys.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify NDA and customer reference language in MSA/Order Form

Hi David,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Legal at Velasys asked me to confirm a couple of points before we finalise the Order Form wiring it into your MSA: 

1) Confidentiality window for product roadmaps — would you accept a 24-month confidentiality period for internal roadmap material, rather than the perpetual language in section 5.2?

2) Customer reference / logo use — we are comfortable with a limited case study and logo placement on an ecosystem page, but we need: (a) prior written approval on any materials that use our name/logo, and (b) a mutual approval window (we typically ask for 5 business days to review).

3) Press announcements — Velasys prefers that press release timing be coordinated and that quotes be pre-approved; can you confirm whether you will accept a publicity annex that requires mutual sign-off before any public announcement?

I've attached our initial redlines (Velasys_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) and a short proposed confidentiality annex (Confidentiality_Annex_draft.docx). Can you loop in your legal/ops and let us know if those are acceptable or if Redwood has alternate language? Prefer to close this week if possible.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Carter
Head of Partnerships, Velasys
S: (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Velasys_MSA_redlines_v3.pdf (pdf), Confidentiality_Annex_draft.docx (docx)

From: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@velasys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify NDA and customer reference language in MSA/Order Form

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Laura (legal) and Kimberly (commercial) to propose concrete redlines and an approval process. Quick answers from my side first:

- Confidentiality window: Redwood prefers a 36-month confidentiality period for roadmap-level artifacts; 24 months may be acceptable for non-sensitive items. Could you flag the specific sections you consider roadmap?
- Logo/use: Agree on prior written approval and a 5-business-day review window is reasonable. We typically require a 10-business-day window for customer quotes/testimonials, but willing to align on 5 for co-marketing assets if Velasys commits a 12-month case study embargo for product details.
- Press/announcements: Yes, we can work with a publicity annex with mutual sign-off. We prefer a short approval SLA (3 business days) for basic joint announcements and longer review for quote attribution.

Suggest next steps:
1) Laura to propose redline language for the confidentiality clause and a short publicity annex (3–10 day windows, escape clauses for regulatory disclosures).
2) Kimberly and I to confirm commercial optics (embargo length, logo sizing/placement).
3) Sophie/Tom to confirm their preferred sign-off contacts.

If that works, Laura — can you draft the annex and mark the tradeoffs?

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie@velasys.com>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Clarify NDA and customer reference language in MSA/Order Form

Hi all — I took a pass at concise redline language so we don't over-index on back-and-forth. Key proposals below (text in *italics* is the proposed replacement):

1) Confidentiality term: replace section 5.2 with: "Confidential Information disclosed in connection with product roadmaps shall remain confidential for a period of thirty-six (36) months from disclosure, after which Recipient's obligation under this Section will expire with respect to such Confidential Information, except for information that constitutes trade secrets under applicable law."

2) Publicity / customer reference: add a new Publicity Annex with the following bullets:
- Prior written approval required for any use of Velasys name, logo, or quotes.
- Velasys will have five (5) business days to review co-marketing assets; Redwood will have three (3) business days to approve joint announcements that primarily quote Redwood spokespeople.
- A 12-month embargo on disclosure of technical roadmap details identified by Velasys as "sensitive"; product positioning/outcome statements may be published earlier with redaction of technical detail.

3) Approval mechanics: include a short table in the annex that lists sign-off contacts (Velasys: Sophie Carter & Tom Hsiao; Redwood: Kimberly Park & Product Marketing). Use Google Drive link for asset drafts and DocuSign for final Order Form changes.

I've attached the draft Confidentiality_Annex_draft.docx with inline edits and an export PDF of the annex. If Velasys legal is fine with the approach, we can incorporate into the Order Form and send a DocuSign packet (DocuSign link below).

Requested timeline: please confirm by COB Wednesday (2026-09-15) so commercial can lock the launch window.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Confidentiality_Annex_draft.docx (docx), Confidentiality_Annex_export.pdf (pdf)

Date: 2026-09-14T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify NDA and customer reference language in MSA/Order Form

Laura, David — thanks for the thorough note and proposed language. Velasys legal reviewed the annex and we can accept the 36-month confidentiality term for roadmap items, provided we retain a carveout for regulatory disclosure.

One small tweak request on the publicity timeline: can we make the mutual review window for joint quotes 7 business days instead of 5? This gives product and comms enough time for legal-safe messaging. Otherwise the annex looks good.

I'll ask legal to accept the minor change and then we can move to DocuSign. I uploaded our signed redlines to the Drive folder and am ready to sign the updated Order Form once you send the DocuSign packet.

Proposed next step: David/Laura — please incorporate the 7-day review window for joint quotes and send final Order Form via DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Sophie
Head of Partnerships, Velasys
